children: Maner Tarkan, an officer serving as President and CCO, reported a sale of Class A Common Stock at a weighted average price of $68.2332 per share. The total sale amount reported was $4,761,176. The reporting person directly owns 33,647 Class A Common Stock following the transaction. The reported price is a weighted average reflecting multiple sales at prices ranging from $68.20 to $68.29 per share.
